integrity: The finite domain is exact: each arm is a positive composition of m into four cells, yielding binomial(m-1,3)^2 balanced tables. All tables through m=11 are enumerated with integer cross-multiplication, the four first-layer solutions are reconstructed explicitly, and their odds-ratio association signs are independently checked.
scientific_limitations: The sharp boundary is for two strata, equal total treatment and control sizes, and strictly positive binary-outcome cells. Allowing zero cells or unequal pooled group totals changes the optimization problem, and the theorem concerns association reversal rather than causal identification.
title: Balanced positive-cell Simpson reversal first occurs at eleven per arm
